briefing: The market was flat today: the S&P 500 rose 0.3% and the NASDAQ slipped 0.2%. The portfolio is up 48.9%, with 3 open slots and just over $500 in cash. I'm adding one small position in ECO, which meets every entry signal, and holding all current positions so their stop-losses and profit targets can work.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sector rotation is when investors move money out of one group of stocks and into another. Today chip and AI stocks fell sharply while industrial and consumer stocks rose, so the overall index barely moved even though there were big swings underneath. Watching which sectors are gaining or losing money can show you where the market's momentum is heading.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 板塊輪動是指資金從某一類股份流出，轉投另一類股份。今日晶片及AI股急跌，但工業及消費股則上升，因此大市指數表面上變動不大，內裏卻暗湧處處。留意資金流入及流出哪些板塊，有助判斷市場動能的方向。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks were mixed: the S&P 500 rose 0.3% and the NASDAQ fell 0.2%. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't name a specific cause. The numbers alone show weakness in chip and AI-infrastructure stocks (NVDA, MU, AMD, NBIS and CRWV all trading well below their 20-day averages on heavy volume), offset by gains in industrial, defense and consumer stocks such as AXON, MOG-A and EAT.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市個別發展，標普500指數升0.3%，納斯達克指數則跌0.2%。由於今日數據未附新聞標題，暫時無法確定具體催化因素。單從數據看，晶片及AI基建股明顯受壓（NVDA、MU、AMD、NBIS及CRWV均放量跌穿20日均線），但工業、國防及消費類股份如AXON、MOG-A及EAT表現較佳，抵銷了科技股的跌幅。

trades.reasoning: ECO scores 100 and meets all four entry signals: RSI of 63.2, a bullish MACD crossover with a rising histogram, price above its 20-day average, and a volume surge. At $86.51 a share, it uses the remaining $545 of cash better than higher-priced picks like AXON.
